test_title: PYST 24: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which city is India's first AI-focused Special Economic Zone (SEZ) being established in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nava Raipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nava Raipur** is set to host **India's first AI-focused Special Economic Zone (SEZ)**, which is planned for establishment in **2025**.
 
• The project is part of India's broader efforts to promote **artificial intelligence (AI) research, innovation, and entrepreneurship**.
 
• Nava Raipur is located in the state of **Chhattisgarh** and is also known as the **newly developed capital city** of the state.
 
• The SEZ aims to create a **world-class ecosystem** for AI, with dedicated infrastructure, facilities, and incentives for industries and startups.
 
• This initiative is expected to **boost employment** and position India as a global leader in **artificial intelligence technologies**.
 
• The choice of Nava Raipur reflects its **modern infrastructure** and **strategic development** as a smart city.
 
• The SEZ will likely focus on sectors like **healthcare, agriculture, education, and manufacturing** using AI-driven solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Hyderabad**__

 __
 
• **Hyderabad** is known as the **IT hub of India** and is home to many leading companies in the technology and innovation sectors.
 
• It hosts institutions like the **International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Hyderabad**, which are significant contributors to AI research in India.
 
• However, it is not the location for India's first AI-focused SEZ.
 
 
 
• **Pune**__
 __
 
• **Pune**, located in Maharashtra, is a major center for **education and information technology**.
 
• The city is home to several IT parks and renowned universities, but it is not chosen for the AI-focused SEZ.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru**__
 
 
• **Bengaluru** is widely referred to as the **Silicon Valley of India** due to its prominence in the IT and startup ecosystem.
 
• It is a hub for **AI research** with many organizations and startups working in this domain.
 
• Despite its significance in the tech industry, Bengaluru is not the location of India's first AI-focused SEZ.
